title: Uniform Circular Motion
summary: Moving in a circle at constant speed: why the velocity changes, and what happens when the pull stops.

ib.note: Circular motion is introduced in MYP 4, developed in MYP 5 and DP

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 4: Describing Motion Around Us

objectives: I can explain why uniform circular motion is accelerated.
I can calculate the speed of an object moving in a circle.
I can predict the path of an object when released from circular motion.
misconceptions: A released object flies straight outwards.
Objects in circles feel an outward force pushing them.
